subject: all six subjects censused — decision 7 fully counted
method: Paginated the 535-item science-fiction pool (200 rows/page, 3 pages) rather than leaving it sampled.

science_fiction_correction.note: The 40-title sample OVERSTATED science fiction by 3x — the opposite direction from the weak subjects, which were all understated. Small samples were noisy in BOTH directions; the pessimism I noted last loop was not a systematic bias, just noise.

unique_title_note: 535 search results collapsed to 462 unique titles — 73 duplicates within IA itself, which the dedup handled silently. Worth stating: the pool size IA reports is not the number of distinct works.
final_answer: 128 new books across six subjects, every one counted rather than estimated. That is the answer to decision 7 as far as these subjects go.
